description_en: This operation detaches one or more rules from a compliance package
description_zh: 本接口用于从指定合规包中移出指定规则
kebab_example: aliyun config detach-config-rule-to-compliance-pack --config-rule-ids cr-6cc4626622af00e70000 --compliance-pack-id cp-5bb1626622af00bd0000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachConfigRuleToCompliancePack

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain a rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a compliance package, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id
